comment: The signal path is noise plus feedback into a Karplus-Strong string, then overdrive, low-pass, high-pass and reverb, with a short body delay closing the loop and an echo send tapped off it. The right channel's body delay is offset by four samples, which decorrelates the two sides into a wide image. Every echo repeat is band-passed at 800Hz and soft-clipped, so long feedback settings degrade towards saturated warbles. The feedback gain jack is 7.2dB per volt, which is not one of the four range shapes, so range is left off it. configBypass passes the input jack to both outputs. The module is a port of Audrey II by Synthux Academy, from the MIT-licensed firmware. The panel prints vorax, pitch, feedback, body, lpf, half, hpf, verb, decay, send, time, echo fb, vol, in, v/oct, fb, lpf, time, body, l and r.
